hints: PCF8574: 7-bit address 0x20–0x27 by A2…A0 (Table 4); the PCF8574A (0x38–0x3F) differs only in this fixed part, so eight of each share a bus (7.1.1)
Standard-mode I2C only: fSCL at most 100 kHz (Table 10)

P0–P7 sink at least 10 mA each at VOL 1 V, VDD 5 V (Table 9); 80 mA for the whole package is the recommended total (2, 10.3); a 0 written while something drives the port HIGH lets a large current flow into it (8.1)
power-on reset below VPOR (typ. 1.3 V, max. 2.4 V) sets every port HIGH with the 100 µA current source (Table 9 note 1)
